adapter_contract.source: external resolved Command,not an automatic action selector
adapter_contract.main: positive-count actor requires dedicated supplied-command API;ordinary main blocked;responses/purchase unchanged
adapter_contract.decrement: local:once on accepted supplied main launch including auxiliary-like commands;no automatic distribution inferred
adapter_contract.unsupported: random policy,automatic timing,phenomenon207 selection,server command authorization

conclusions: confuseEverybody iterates the !dead input roster and adds3 to its existing count;it does not reset to3 or impose a client cap. HP0 alone is not a dead flag.

The useAttackItems receiver decrements its current source once only when count>0,including empty item arrays. Neither item count nor viewer changes the decrement. A confused local source with an empty array also gets one empty gift-placeholder widget.

pray/discard/sacrifice/useDefenseItems receiver events alone do not decrement. removeCurses also leaves the separate count unchanged. No confuse/removeConfusion action is recognized by this receiver. This does not establish the complete server event sequence for any logical command.
advanceGF chooses the supplied player pane and shows a confusion animation when its count is positive,without decrement. This is not a startTurn wire action.

sc8 stores its raw number and draws a noninteractive positive-count frame. Death clears it;endGame clears every !dead player. Fresh player projection applies positive decoded counts,then death clears them.
fv.fF still activates local hand/target/command controls for a positive-count owner. This display path is not evidence of server permission to submit manual moves during confusion.
The local dedicated external resolved-command API and its decrement stage are explicit experimental restrictions,not a public-client automatic selection/scheduling implementation.
limitations: No authoritative server selector,legal-action distribution,response automation,CP/MP choice,target distribution,no-item policy or timeout trigger is present in these receiver facts. JA/EN promise loss of control for3turns but do not specify those choices.
The unsafe+3 UI examples deliberately show raw JavaScript number behavior;the adapter rejects arithmetic outside signed safe integers. No arbitrary small confusion cap is claimed.
Old Flash Jupiter ILLUSION changes fake hand appearance and is not current289 confusion. No old confusion policy is used as evidence.

DOM/resource visuals,Future delays,used-pane rendering and final command widgets are scaffolding. Real event dispatch,player decoder,count setter,live filtering and manual-control branch are unchanged. No network/account/application startup runs.
